title: Funeral home payment for brother's service

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, this is Evergreen Memorial Chapel. The balance for Walter's service and interment is eleven thousand four hundred. I am sorry for your loss.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Thank you. I have the itemized contract we signed on Wednesday. I will pay from my bank, is ACH all right?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: ACH is fine. Whenever you are ready, there is no rush on our end.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: I have a copy of the contract too, Mom. The amount is right.

review_note: Real funeral invoice, signed contract. Over 3x baseline so H-03 holds. Completes after check-in and review.
